messages:
Maya: Quick async stand — posting what I did / blockers / today so folks can chime in.

Maya: What I did: demo call with NovaHealth yesterday, walked through Dedicated pilot options + BYOK flow. Customer asked for HSM/KMS details and on-prem connector timeline.
Maya: Blockers: need a short security FAQ for BYOK/HSM (cust wants cert timeline), and an answer re: demo deployment cadence — can we guarantee a staging deploy next Tue?

Jordan: Nice — I can draft the BYOK FAQ. Have answers for lifecycle and key rotation already, will adapt to NovaHealth wording. ETA EOD today. :+1:

Priya: On the staging deploy: eng infra flagged an image-signing gap for on-prem package. I pinged eng-infra to land a small change — cc @Ravi. If that's quick we can do Tue, otherwise Wed.

Ravi: I'm on it. Looked at the package signing checklist; missing one cert step for our internal tooling. I can add an automated step to the release job. Should be a 2-4 hour change.

Evan: FYI — PR 1123 (github.com/redwood/integrations/pull/1123) is still awaiting an SE review. It's the connector config for KMS keys. Jordan / Maya can you review the example text? It's what we demo for the customer.

Maya: I'll review PR 1123 today after stand. Key asks for the customer: 1) BYOK workflow doc 2) what data leaves customer VPC (short bullet) 3) timeline for on-prem package hardened image.

Jordan: I'll add that small 'what leaves VPC' bullet. Suggest we borrow the wording from our privacy whitepaper and keep it 3 bullets max.

Priya: Security question — NovaHealth asked if we support HSM-backed keys (Y/N) and if key wraps happen inside their VPC. Ravi / sec-bot, any quick confirmation?

sec-bot: Automated note: For Dedicated pilots, Redwood supports BYOK via KMS integrations. HSM-backed keys are supported when customers provide an external key provider reachable over the private network. Key material never stored in Redwood control plane. See https://redwood.example.com/security/byok for details.

Ravi: Re: HSM — confirmed. We can integrate with customer HSM if network path is established (VPC peering / private link). Key unwrap/wrap happens at the customer's KMS/HSM endpoint by design. I'll add a 1-pager to the FAQ.

Evan: For the demo infra: small ops ask — can someone from sales confirm the exact model/sequence length they'll test? It changes the perf profile we show.

Maya: They'll run standard chat + 2 long-form prompts (6k tokens). I'll confirm by EOD.

Jordan: Quick code-review ping: Evan's PR needs a small docs update in examples/ byok.md — evan, can you add the YAML snippet below so field names match the portal?

Jordan: ```yaml
connector: kms-external
endpoint: https://kms.novahealth.internal
wrap: true
```

Evan: Will do. Adding now.

Priya: Blocker for rollout: legal asked for a signed DPA addendum for on-prem pilot. Sales, can you surface the contract contact? Maya?

Maya: Contract lead is Amy at NovaHealth — copying details in DM. I'll get the contact for the DPA today and loop legal.

Ravi: Ops note — deploying a signed installer for on-prem requires we'll host the image in their bucket or do S3 cross-account copy. Which does sales prefer?

Maya: Prefer S3 cross-account copy (simpler for them). I'll confirm but flagging for eng infra.

Jordan: Small follow-up: once PR merged and BYOK FAQ is live, can we get a one-slide summary for customer calls? I can draft it if you want.

Maya: Yes please — one slide: BYOK + HSM bullets, what leaves VPC, staging deploy ETA. Jordan, if you draft I'll polish and send to NovaHealth.

Evan: Merge plan — I'll cut a release branch after PR 1123 merges and run the signed-image job. tagging @deploy-bot for deploy window Tue 08:00-12:00 PT.

deploy-bot: Scheduled: release branch build queued. Expected image signing success window Tue 09:00 PT. Will post updates here. :gear:

Maya: Summary of open action items: Jordan - BYOK FAQ + 1-slide (EOD). Evan - update PR 1123 docs + merge (today). Ravi - add signing step to release job (today). Maya - confirm token lengths and Amy contact (EOD). Priya - legal follow-up for DPA once contact provided.

Priya: Acknowledged.

Ravi: Acknowledged, starting the release job change now.

Jordan: I'll drop the draft slide in this thread when ready. :eyes:

Maya: Thanks all — ping here if anything blocks. We'll aim to confirm the Tue slot by EOD. :rocket:
